QuestInfo.name: [Legends] Words for Aspiring Legends
QuestInfo.0: The Legends Awards runs from 12/7/2011 to 1/31/2012! Talk to the Maple Administrator about it.
QuestInfo.1: The Maple Administrator is giving gifts to all users who start leveling their new job during the Legends Festival, from TKTKTK to TKTKTK. You can receive Legends Coins for your 2nd, 3rd and 4th job advancements, and a Legends Ring when you reach lv. 50.
QuestInfo.2: The Maple Administrator is giving gifts to all users who start leveling their new job during the Legends Festival, from TKTKTK to TKTKTK. You can receive Legends Coins for your 2nd, 3rd and 4th job advancements, and a Legends Ring when you reach lv. 50.

0.0: Hello, #h0#! You know about the Legends Awards, the biggest event in Maple World yet, right? It runs from 12/7/2011 to 1/31/2012, so join the events and earn lots of rewards!
0.1: #h0#, since you chose a new job, you can receive a gift from Cassandra at level 50: your very own Legends Ring! On top of that, you will receive Legends Awards Coins when you complete your 2nd, 3rd, and 4th Job Advancements.

1.0: This is a Festival of the Legends, by the Legends, and for the Legends! Enjoy!
